items.source: key - the key whose associated value is to be returned
items.translation: key - 要返回其关联值的键

items.source: Can return null if the cache can immediately determine that it contains no mapping for this key (for example, through an in-memory key map). Otherwise, the cached value will be returned in the CompletableFuture, with null indicating a late-determined cache miss. A nested Cache.ValueWrapper potentially indicates a nullable cached value; the cached value may also be represented as a plain element if null values are not supported. Calling code needs to be prepared to handle all those variants of the result returned by this method.
items.translation: 如果缓存可以立即确定该键没有映射（例如，通过内存中的键映射），则可能返回 `null`。否则，缓存的值将在 CompletableFuture 中返回，其中 `null` 表示稍后确定的缓存未命中。嵌套的 Cache.ValueWrapper 可能表示可空的缓存值；如果缓存不支持空值，缓存值也可能以普通元素形式表示。调用代码需要准备好处理此方法返回的所有这些结果变体。

items.source: If the cache is supposed to be compatible with CompletableFuture and reactive interactions, the put operation needs to be effectively non-blocking, with any backend write-through happening asynchronously. This goes along with a cache implemented and configured to support retrieve(Object) and retrieve(Object, Supplier).
items.translation: 如果缓存需要与 `CompletableFuture` 和响应式交互兼容，则 `put` 操作必须是有效的非阻塞操作，任何后端写回都必须异步进行。这还需要缓存实现并配置为支持 `retrieve(Object)` 和 `retrieve(Object, Supplier)`。

items.source: If the cache is supposed to be compatible with CompletableFuture and reactive interactions, the evict operation needs to be effectively non-blocking, with any backend write-through happening asynchronously. This goes along with a cache implemented and configured to support retrieve(Object) and retrieve(Object, Supplier).
items.translation: 如果缓存需要与 `CompletableFuture` 和响应式交互兼容，则驱逐操作必须是有效的非阻塞操作，任何后端写回都必须异步进行。这与实现并配置为支持 `retrieve(Object)` 和 `retrieve(Object, Supplier)` 的缓存相一致。

items.source: If the cache is supposed to be compatible with CompletableFuture and reactive interactions, the clear operation needs to be effectively non-blocking, with any backend write-through happening asynchronously. This goes along with a cache implemented and configured to support retrieve(Object) and retrieve(Object, Supplier).
items.translation: 如果缓存需要与 `CompletableFuture` 和响应式交互兼容，则清除操作必须是有效的非阻塞操作，任何后端写透操作都需异步执行。这还需要缓存实现并配置为支持 `retrieve(Object)` 和 `retrieve(Object, Supplier)`。
如果缓存中不包含此键的映射，则返回null；否则，将返回缓存的值（该值本身可能为null），其类型为Cache.ValueWrapper。

items.source: Note: This variant of get does not allow for differentiating between a cached null value and no cache entry found at all. Use the standard get(Object) variant for that purpose instead.
items.translation: 注意：此 `get` 变体无法区分缓存的 `null` 值与完全未找到缓存条目。请使用标准 get(Object) 变体来实现该目的。

items.source: The default implementation delegates to get(Object) and put(Object, Object) along the lines of the code snippet above.
items.translation: 默认实现委托给 get(Object) 和 put(Object, Object)，方式如上代码片段所示。

items.source: Note: Due to the generic use of caching, it is recommended that implementations allow storage of null values (for example to cache methods that return null).
items.translation: 注意： 由于缓存的通用性，建议实现允许存储 `null` 值（例如用于缓存返回 `null` 的方法）。

items.source: If the valueLoader throws an exception, it is wrapped in a Cache.ValueRetrievalException
items.translation: 如果 `valueLoader` 抛出异常，它将被包装在 `Cache.ValueRetrievalException` 中。

items.source: The default implementation delegates to evict(Object), returning false for not-determined prior presence of the key. Cache providers and in particular cache decorators are encouraged to perform immediate eviction if possible (for example, in case of generally deferred cache operations within a transaction) and to reliably determine prior presence of the given key.
items.translation: 默认实现委托给 evict(Object)，对于未确定键的先前存在性返回 false。鼓励缓存提供程序（尤其是缓存装饰器）在可能的情况下执行即时驱逐（例如，在事务中通常延迟的缓存操作的情况下），并可靠地确定给定键的先前存在性。

items.source: Serves primarily as an SPI for Spring's annotation-based caching model (Cacheable and co) and secondarily as an API for direct usage in applications.
items.translation: 主要作为 Spring 基于注解的缓存模型（Cacheable 等）的 SPI，其次作为应用程序直接使用的 API。

items.source: Actual registration may be performed in an asynchronous or deferred fashion, with subsequent lookups possibly not seeing the entry yet. This may for example be the case with transactional cache decorators. Use putIfAbsent(Object, Object) for guaranteed immediate registration.
items.translation: 实际的注册可能是异步或延迟执行的，随后的查找可能尚未看到该条目。例如，事务性缓存装饰器可能会出现这种情况。请使用 putIfAbsent(Object, Object) 以确保立即注册。

items.source: Actual eviction may be performed in an asynchronous or deferred fashion, with subsequent lookups possibly still seeing the entry. This may for example be the case with transactional cache decorators. Use evictIfPresent(Object) for guaranteed immediate removal.
items.translation: 实际驱逐可能是异步或延迟执行的，随后的查找仍可能看到该条目。例如，事务性缓存装饰器可能就是这种情况。请使用evictIfPresent(Object)以确保立即移除。

items.source: Actual clearing may be performed in an asynchronous or deferred fashion, with subsequent lookups possibly still seeing the entries. This may for example be the case with transactional cache decorators. Use invalidate() for guaranteed immediate removal of entries.
items.translation: 实际的清除可能是异步或延迟执行的，随后的查找仍可能看到这些条目。例如，事务性缓存装饰器就可能存在这种情况。请使用invalidate()来确保立即移除条目。

items.source: If possible, implementations should ensure that the loading operation is synchronized so that the specified valueLoader is only called once in case of concurrent access on the same key.
items.translation: 如果可能，实现应确保加载操作是同步的，以便在并发访问同一键的情况下，指定的 `valueLoader` 仅被调用一次。

items.source: Wrapper exception to be thrown from get(Object, Callable) in case of the value loader callback failing with an exception.
items.translation: 用于在值加载器回调因异常而失败时，从get(Object, Callable)抛出的包装异常。

items.source: Return the value to which this cache maps the specified key, obtaining that value from valueLoader if necessary.
items.translation: 返回此缓存映射到指定键的值，必要时从 `valueLoader` 获取该值。

items.source: Return the cache name.
items.translation: 返回缓存名称。

items.source: Return the underlying native cache provider.
items.translation: 返回底层原生缓存提供者。

items.source:
Invalidate the cache through removing all mappings, expecting all
entries to be immediately invisible for subsequent lookups.
items.translation: 通过移除所有映射来使缓存失效，期望所有条目在随后的查找中立即不可见。

items.source: the value to which this cache maps the specified key, contained within a CompletableFuture which may also be empty when a cache miss has been late-determined. A straight null being returned means that the cache immediately determined that it contains no mapping for this key. A Cache.ValueWrapper contained within the CompletableFuture indicates a cached value that is potentially null; this is sensible in a late-determined scenario where a regular CompletableFuture-contained null indicates a cache miss. However, a cache may also return a plain value if it does not support the actual caching of null values, avoiding the extra level of value wrapping. Spring's cache processing can deal with all such implementation strategies.
items.translation: 此缓存将指定键映射到的值，包含在一个CompletableFuture中，该值在缓存未命中被延迟确定时也可能为空。直接返回null意味着缓存立即确定不包含此键的映射。包含在CompletableFuture中的Cache.ValueWrapper表示一个可能为null的缓存值；这在延迟确定的场景中是合理的，因为普通的包含在CompletableFuture中的null表示缓存未命中。然而，如果缓存不支持实际缓存null值，它也可以返回一个普通值，从而避免额外的值包装层。Spring 的缓存处理可以应对所有这些实现策略。

items.source: the value to which this cache maps the specified key, contained within a Cache.ValueWrapper which may also hold a cached null value. A straight null being returned means that the cache contains no mapping for this key.
items.translation: 此缓存将指定键映射到的值，包含在 `Cache.ValueWrapper` 中，该包装器也可能持有缓存的 `null` 值。直接返回一个 `null` 意味着此键在缓存中没有映射。

items.source: type - the required type of the returned value (may be null to bypass a type check; in case of a null value found in the cache, the specified type is irrelevant)
items.translation: `type` - 返回值的必需类型（可为 `null` 以绕过类型检查；如果在缓存中找到 `null` 值，则指定的类型无关紧要）

items.source: Cache.ValueRetrievalException - if the valueLoader throws an exception
items.translation: `Cache.ValueRetrievalException` - 如果 `valueLoader` 抛出异常

items.source: the value to which this cache maps the specified key (which may be null itself), or also null if the cache contains no mapping for this key
items.translation: 此缓存将指定键（可能本身就是 `null`）映射到的值，或者如果该缓存不包含此键的映射，则为 `null`。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if a cache entry has been found but failed to match the specified type
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果已找到缓存条目但未能匹配指定的类型

items.source: key - the key with which the specified value is to be associated
items.translation: key - 用于关联指定值的键

items.source: value - the value to be associated with the specified key
items.translation: value - 要与指定键关联的值

items.source: key - the key whose mapping is to be removed from the cache
items.translation: key - 要从缓存中移除其映射的键

items.source: Null values always indicate a user-level null value with this method. The provided CompletableFuture handle produces a value or raises an exception. If the valueLoader raises an exception, it will be propagated to the returned CompletableFuture handle.
items.translation: 空值始终表示此方法中的用户级 `null` 值。提供的 CompletableFuture 处理程序会生成一个值或抛出异常。如果 `valueLoader` 抛出异常，该异常将传播到返回的 `CompletableFuture` 处理程序中。

items.source:
If the cache previously contained a mapping for this key, the old
value is replaced by the specified value.
items.translation: 如果缓存之前包含此键的映射，则旧值将被指定值替换。

items.source: This is equivalent to:
items.translation: 这等同于：

items.source: Return the value to which this cache maps the specified key, wrapped in a CompletableFuture.
items.translation: 返回此缓存将指定键映射到的值，并将其包装在CompletableFuture中。

items.source: A (wrapper) object representing a cache value.
items.translation: 代表缓存值的包装对象。

items.source: Clear the cache through removing all mappings.
items.translation: 通过删除所有映射来清除缓存。

items.source: Evict the mapping for this key from this cache if it is present.
items.translation: 如果该键存在，则从当前缓存中移除其映射。

items.source:
Evict the mapping for this key from this cache if it is present,
expecting the key to be immediately invisible for subsequent lookups.
items.translation: 如果该键存在，则从当前缓存中移除此键的映射，并期望在随后的查找中该键立即不可见。

items.source: Return the value to which this cache maps the specified key.
items.translation: 返回该缓存映射到指定键的值。

items.source:
Return the value to which this cache maps the specified key,
generically specifying a type that return value will be cast to.
items.translation: 返回此缓存映射到指定键的值，泛型地指定返回值将被转换到的类型。

items.source: Associate the specified value with the specified key in this cache.
items.translation: 在此缓存中将指定的值与指定的键关联。

items.source:
Atomically associate the specified value with the specified key in this cache
if it is not set already.
items.translation: 如果该缓存中尚未设置，则原子地将指定值与指定键关联。

items.source: the value to which this cache maps the specified key (which may be null itself), or also null if the cache did not contain any mapping for that key prior to this call. Returning null is therefore an indicator that the given value has been associated with the key.
items.translation: 此缓存将指定键（其本身可能为null）映射到的值，或者如果在此调用之前该缓存不包含针对该键的任何映射，则也返回null。因此，返回null表示给定的value已与键关联。

items.source: the value to which this cache maps the specified key, contained within a CompletableFuture which will never be null. The provided future is expected to produce a value or raise an exception.
items.translation: 此缓存将指定键映射到的值，该值包含在一个 `CompletableFuture` 中，该值永远不会为 `null`。提供的 Future 预期将产生一个值或抛出异常。

items.source: true if the cache was known to have a mapping for this key before, false if it did not (or if prior presence could not be determined)
items.translation: 如果缓存之前已知对此键有映射，则返回`true`；否则（或无法确定先前是否存在）返回`false`。

items.source: true if the cache was known to have mappings before, false if it did not (or if prior presence of entries could not be determined)
items.translation: true 如果缓存之前已知存在映射， false 如果不存在（或无法确定条目之前的存在性）
